# silas

> Silas is a Rails-native framework for durable AI agents: capabilities as
> plain files inside an existing Rails app, exactly-once tool effects (effect
> + ledger in one database transaction), human-in-the-loop approvals that
> park at zero compute, crash-safe turns that resume byte-identical after
> kill -9, replay-safe context compaction, an operator inbox mounted in the
> host app, and deterministic agent evals. Ruby gem; Rails >= 8.1 + Solid
> Queue.

Quickstart: `rails new my-agent -m https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/templates/desk.rb`
(or `bundle add silas && bin/rails g silas:install` in an existing app).
All docs below are plain markdown and also ship inside the gem package.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/README.md): overview and quick start
- [Tutorial](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/tutorial.md): build a refund desk, one primitive per chapter
- [Guarantees](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/guarantees.md): exactly-once, in-doubt parking, crash-safe turns, verification
- [Tools & approvals](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/tools.md): effect modes, approval policies, skills
- [Agents & staff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/agents.md): named agents, subagents, handoffs, schedules
- [Memory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/memory.md): approval-gated triples with provenance
- [Channels](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/channels.md): Slack, email, and generating transports
- [Inbox & API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/inbox-and-api.md): operator surface, JSON + SSE, streaming, structured answers
- [Connections](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/connections.md): remote MCP servers as YAML files
- [Evals](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/evals.md): scripted model decisions, real ledger, deploy gates
- [Budgets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/budgets.md): per-turn caps, parking, human top-ups
- [Cancellation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/cancellation.md): cancel semantics mid-flight
- [Sandbox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/sandbox.md): code execution, Docker seam, hermetic
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/configuration.md): every Silas.configure option with defaults
- [Providers & gateways](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/providers.md): any RubyLLM provider, OpenRouter, OpenAI-compatible gateways, local runtimes
- [Conventions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/conventions.md): contracts the UI and API keep
- [Deploy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/DEPLOY.md): production notes from the chaos harness
